target_cohort: Exactly 52 fixed DEV500 questions for which a correct generated K8 candidate exists (hindsight oracle) but original gold-blind result plurality selects a wrong answer

mechanism.insight: Tie-break changes alone cannot materially close the 52-case correct-candidate/incorrect-selection gap. Correct candidate support is typically a minority; require question/schema/SQL-grounded independent verification rather than popularity alone.

source_only_diversity_check.interpretation: SQL text diversity is not execution-result diversity; 24/52 have 8 distinct normalized SQL strings. Do not use this as evidence of candidate correctness.

next_gate.task: Develop ONE preregistered, gold-blind semantic compatibility/reranking rule from source-disjoint BIRD TRAIN examples, then compare to frozen physical-result plurality and measure marginal improvement and actual CPU cost.
next_gate.requirement: No DEV500 gold/reference SQL or case-specific threshold fitting; select feature/rubric on TRAIN only. Preserve same fixed Qwen3.5-9B. Report paired rescues/regressions and both task/physical-DB cluster uncertainty on an independent, prospectively frozen evaluation. Do not prematurely open reserved HOLDOUT300.
blocked_actions: posthoc tuning on the 52 diagnostic cases

limitations: This corpus was selected retrospectively by original DEV500 outcome; the diagnostic counts are not a new prospective score, and should not be used as a fitting dataset.
Publisher reference SQL was used to annotate correct support counts only AFTER original Qwen candidates, execution results, and selector indexes were fixed; gold was not passed to Qwen.
The original BIRD physical databases are not source-disjoint; the 52 tasks share only 11 total DEV databases with historical exposure.
The 52/500 theoretical selector gap is an oracle bound, not a score the proposed semantic checker has achieved.
No benchmark output improvement or training/model claim from this replay.
